label: Late runs — identification as indictment

recentEvents.value: The latest haul, graded aloud, one name at a time: heating stone — goblin make, kept a nursery warm; memorial lamp — he will say whose shelf it sat on; a child's painted bowl — no grade.
The hero asked for the appraisal values. He answered: shall I grade the portrait?

unresolvedConflicts.value: He calls the row of named objects 'evidence of corruption spreading'. The assay table has stopped calling them anything but what they are.

temporaryObjective.value: Name every object and its owner until the ledger of names is longer than his list of Sovereigns.

notes: The escalation endpoint: identification-as-indictment, ending on 'Shall I grade the portrait?' (profile notes).
